delivered.statement: AUM crossed INR 5 lakh crores; ended FY26 at INR 510,000 crores
Q4 AUM grew 22.4%, PAT grew 26.7%, added record INR 25,500 crores
Booked 12.9 million loans, added 3.93 million new customers in Q4
Full year: 52.5 million loans booked, 17.5 million new customers
Loan loss to AUM 175 bps vs 197 bps prior year; improved
Gold loans grew 115%, now 3.5% of total AUM
Board recommended INR 6 per equity share dividend for FY26

themes: FinAI transformation: 203 AI resources expanding to 363; 600+ autonomous agents planned for FY27
Gold loan momentum: 115% growth, aggressive branch expansion, target 5% of AUM
MSME risk mitigation: proactive pruning, monthly volume cut from 1,800 to 1,400 crores
Credit quality: Stage 2-3 assets down 430 crores sequentially, vintage metrics improving
AI customer experience: SMS/text BOTs live, 100% AI-generated videos, AI agents cost 1/3
Balance sheet resilience: bullet-proofing approach, profit growth targeting exceed balance sheet growth
risks: Geopolitical uncertainty: guidance assumes easing tensions and macro stability; 3 crises experienced in FY26
MSME recovery timing: still requires stabilization by June 2026, worst said to be behind
2-wheeler captive wind-down: 13% of GNPA in Q4, to reach <1500 crores by Sept
NIM moderation: FY27 guidance expects marginal decline, contingent on interest rate movements

analyst_pushback.question: Credit cost 145-160 guidance—does it account for geopolitical deterioration?
analyst_pushback.response: No; guidance assumes stable macro. We enter with tailwinds, can absorb if environment weakens.
analyst_pushback.evidence: entering year on credit costs with tailwinds, not headwinds

analyst_pushback.question: Can ROA 4.4-4.6% be achieved without NIM expansion in FY27?
analyst_pushback.response: Yes; opex improvements and 22-24% growth provide headroom without NIM expansion needed.
analyst_pushback.evidence: sufficient headroom available in ROA profile from growth and opex levers

analyst_pushback.question: What portfolio metrics show confidence MSME worst is behind?
analyst_pushback.response: Micro-not-macro business; selective on location and underwriting; guidance based on stabilized environment.
analyst_pushback.evidence: pruned INR 100 crores, cut monthly volume from 1,800 to 1,400 crores

analyst_pushback.question: Will 60% provision coverage ratio unwind in FY27?
analyst_pushback.response: Bottoms-up quarterly exercise; focused on resiliency, will remain in corridor or increase.
analyst_pushback.evidence: bullet proofing balance sheet is priority, provisions based on forward models

tone_evidence: strong quarter all metrics, proud milestone, reasonably optimistic; contingent on geopolitical stability
